race.title: Valda Energy Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: WAY OF STARS looks to have plenty in his favour in a stacked renewal, and he may well gain compensation for his Chepstow near miss. The main danger could be handicap debutant Lexington Wood , who has plenty of untapped potential, while Dan Skelton's Sytadel is another who is probably well treated. Eben Zaabeel is potentially most interesting of a healthy Irish contingent, his shrewd connections landing a touch in this corresponding race back in 2013. WAY OF STARS (IRE) LEXINGTON WOOD (FR) SYTADEL (FR)
